primary_justification: Source-reconciliation evidence supports a duplicate-dimension-path false blocker mechanism: the blocker group reports 11 extra pipeline rows with $220.42 million of output fair value and zero matched source fair value, while current-period raw source rows for sampled blocker identifiers are present but all carry match_status collapsed_duplicate_dimension_path.

html_citations.reason: Coordinate candidate shows Apidos CLO XXV - Class E1R3 as a current-period position row in a selected SOI table; numeric source support remains the raw/XBRL source row, not the HTML text.

patch_summary: Propose a bounded source-reconciliation change so current-period raw source rows marked collapsed_duplicate_dimension_path remain eligible for identity matching against unified output rows when identifier, report date, accession, and fair value support the same production position; add a false-positive test ensuring true duplicate dimension collapses are still not counted twice.
source_reconciliation_effect: Expected to reduce or clear this blocking_pipeline_only_position residual by matching the affected pipeline rows to their current-period raw source facts instead of treating them as zero-source extras, without suppressing unrelated missing_from_pipeline residuals.
gav_effect: Context only; GAV already passes with gav_ratio 1.0052 and should not be used as an independent pass/fail claim.
tests_validation_plan: pytest tests/test_bdc_cik_review.py tests/test_bdc_cik_validator.py tests/test_bdc_source_reconciliation.py; python -m pipeline.main --unified --validate
residual_risk: The bundle provides only sampled extra-in-pipeline identifiers and one exact HTML coordinate citation; the full set of 11 output rows should be checked after patching to confirm each has a legitimate current-period source fact and that duplicate-dimension collapse semantics are not weakened globally.
reviewer_notes: Do not patch generated CSVs or validation outputs. Generic HTML matches on terms such as Subordinated Notes were not relied on because they can point to different issuers; the mechanism is based on source reconciliation and raw current-period source rows.
